title: UzEngine Locale
description: UzEngine localization file (.uzlocale) — string table for a specific culture/language. Keys are dot-separated identifiers. Values are display strings with optional ICU MessageFormat placeholders for pluralization, gender, and variable substitution.

fallback.description: Fallback locale tag. If a key is missing in this locale, the engine looks it up in the fallback (e.g., 'pt-BR' falls back to 'pt').

strings.description: Flat key-value map of localized strings. Keys use dot notation for namespacing (e.g., 'ui.menu.play', 'dialog.npc.greeting'). Values support ICU MessageFormat for pluralization: '{count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}'.
